subject: RE: lunch
body_plain:
I've got a conflict on Friday. How about Tuesday or maybe breakfast during
the weekend?

Shawn
--------------------------
Sent from my BlackBerry Wireless Handheld (www.BlackBerry.net)


-----Original Message-----
From: Vince.J.Kaminski@enron.com <Vince.J.Kaminski@enron.com>
To: Cumberland, Shawn <Shawn.Cumberland@ElPaso.com>
Sent: Wed Dec 05 10:35:20 2001
Subject: RE: lunch

Shawn,

I was about to call you. I have an emergency here.
Can we push the lunch to Friday?


Vince

    -----Original Message-----
   From:   "Cumberland, Shawn" <Shawn.Cumberland@ElPaso.com>@ENRON
   Sent:   Wednesday, December 05, 2001 10:33 AM
   To:     Kaminski, Vince J
   Cc:     Hatten, Shelia
   Subject:  lunch

   Vince:

   Would it be trouble if we started lunch at 12:30?

   If it is, I'll still pick you up at noon.

   Thanks.  Shawn
